Who we are

We are Team RassLexx from Murager Specialized Lyceum, and we have been doing robotics for three years. In our first season, we won the Champions Award at the Central Asian FLL Championship. In our next season, we became Inspire Award winners and Winning Alliance Captains, continuing to grow and achieve new goals.
